items.title: Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: I don't remember him. I never knew him but he was.

ctx.x: Yeah, he did. When I first started out, I was so fast to start the playing, even before he'd knock off a number. That's what we used to do in Yorling, you know, that stomp off. So, first he called me a round of go, because I was always ready. That's where the first of it started. That was back in New Orleans. Yeah, that was in Yorling's. When I first played with Oren, and how that happened was his drummer, a fellow by the name of Henry Martin, I don't remember him. I never knew him but he was. I used to go down…
Well, I wonder, because they called him Baby Hall.
